back.es: ni = not even (in a negative sentence); also nor
back.example: I don't have even one peso / I don't have a single peso.

note: The hint correctly rules out "ni siquiera", which makes this "not even" sense distinct from the "nor" card, but the example sentence just repeats the prompt word for word, so a different sentence, such as "Ni lo pienses." (Don't even think about it.), would give learners more to learn from.
